line_items.description: Emergency Express Silk Shirt De-Staining (1-hour turnaround)
Midnight Artisanal Truffle Cashews & Botanical Craft Tonic
Overnight Valet Parking with Ultra-Fast EV Surcharge

reasoning: Two-night Berlin stay for the FinTech Summit; the nights of March 12 and 13, 2024 begin on a Tuesday and a Wednesday, so no night falls on a weekend or public holiday and the weekend flowchart does not apply. The note names the FinTech Summit and both nights fall in March, the event window, so the trade-fair override in Chapter 9 replaces Berlin's €160 Tier 2 cap with the €200 event surcharge cap; each €185 night is within the override and is reimbursed in full, and the 'Executive Loft' category earns no higher or lower cap either way. The folio documents an emergency de-staining of a silk shirt ahead of the speaking session, which establishes that business attire was soiled during the trip, so the €38.50 garment rescue is reimbursable up to the €25 short-stay laundry cap and €13.50 is deducted. Both minibar lines are deducted in full. The note identifies the rental EV, so the €70 two-night valet parking with EV surcharge is reimbursed up to €30 per night, i.e. €60, with €10 deducted. City tax is reimbursed in full. VAT is allocated at the folio's single printed 7% rate on the reimbursed net charges, which deducts €3.82 of the €35.67 VAT.
